impact.en: Reduced visibility on roads during heavy downpours
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa uwezo wa kuona barabarani wakati wa mvua kubwa

en: Drive slowly with headlights on.
Keep a safe distance from other vehicles.
Plan journeys to avoid the heaviest rain periods.
sw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele.
Weka umbali salama kati yako na magari mengine.
Panga safari kuepuka vipindi vya mvua kubwa.

impact.en: Slippery and water-covered roads in a few areas
impact.sw: Barabara kuteleza na kufunikwa na maji katika maeneo machache

en: Reduce speed and avoid sudden braking.
Do not drive, ride or walk through water flowing across roads.
Pedestrians: walk on higher ground, away from drains and ditches.
sw: Punguza mwendo na epuka kukanyaga breki ghafla.
Usiendeshe gari, pikipiki wala kutembea kwenye maji yanayotiririka barabarani.
Watembea kwa miguu: tembeeni sehemu za mwinuko, mbali na mitaro.

impact.en: A few homes in low-lying areas affected by surface water
impact.sw: Nyumba chache katika maeneo ya mabondeni kuathiriwa na maji yaliyotuama

en: Clear waste and blockages from drains and water channels around homes.
Raise valuables, food and documents above floor level.
Place sandbags or soil-filled bags at doorways where needed.
sw: Safisha na ondoa taka kwenye mitaro na njia za maji kuzunguka makazi.
Inua vitu vya thamani, chakula na nyaraka juu ya sakafu.
Weka magunia ya mchanga au udongo milangoni inapohitajika.

impact.en: Minor disruption to social and economic activities in a few areas
impact.sw: Kuathirika kidogo kwa shughuli za kijamii na kiuchumi katika maeneo machache

en: Keep a reserve of food, drinking water, cash, medicines and a first-aid kit.
Save the emergency number 190 and the numbers of your local leaders.
Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review contingency plans, update the list of people with special needs and identify safe areas and routes.
Share this advisory with neighbours and relatives, especially older persons, people with disabilities and pregnant women.
sw: Weka akiba ya chakula, maji ya kunywa, fedha, dawa na vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza.
Hifadhi namba ya dharura 190 na namba za viongozi wa eneo lako.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura, boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum na bainisheni maeneo na njia salama.
Wapatie taarifa hii majirani na ndugu, hasa wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na wajawazito.

impact.en: Risk of lightning strikes during thunderstorms
impact.sw: Hatari ya kupigwa na radi wakati wa ngurumo

en: Go into a solid building when you hear thunder; do not shelter under trees.
Get out of the water and bring boats to shore.
Stay away from open fields and metal fences.
Wait 30 minutes after the last thunder before going outside.
sw: Ingia ndani ya jengo imara unaposikia ngurumo; usijikinge chini ya miti.
Toka majini na rudisha vyombo vya majini ufukweni.
Kaa mbali na maeneo ya wazi na uzio wa chuma.
Subiri dakika 30 baada ya ngurumo ya mwisho kabla ya kutoka nje.

impact.en: Risk of children drowning or falling into open wells, pits, ponds and drains
impact.sw: Hatari ya watoto kuzama au kutumbukia kwenye visima, mashimo, mabwawa na mitaro iliyo wazi

en: Do not let children play, swim or stand near ponds, wells, dams and riverbanks.
Cover or fence open wells, pits and latrines.
Village/Mtaa leaders: mark or fence abandoned mining and construction pits.
sw: Usiwaruhusu watoto kucheza, kuogelea au kusimama karibu na mabwawa, visima, malambo na kingo za mito.
Funika au zungushia uzio visima, mashimo na vyoo vilivyo wazi.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: wekeni alama au uzio kwenye mashimo ya machimbo na ujenzi yaliyoachwa wazi.

impact.en: Localised soil erosion and waterlogging of farmland
impact.sw: Mmomonyoko wa udongo na kujaa kwa maji shambani katika maeneo machache

en: Open drainage furrows in fields.
Delay fertiliser application and spraying until the rain eases.
Avoid planting in waterlogged or flood-prone low-lying fields.
sw: Fungua mifereji ya kutolea maji shambani.
Ahirisha uwekaji wa mbolea na unyunyiziaji wa viuatilifu hadi mvua ipungue.
Epuka kupanda kwenye mashamba yaliyojaa maji au ya mabondeni.

impact.en: Increased mosquito breeding in standing water
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa mazalia ya mbu kwenye maji yaliyotuama

en: Drain standing water around homes.
Cover water containers.
Sleep under an insecticide-treated net every night.
sw: Ondoa maji yaliyotuama kuzunguka nyumba.
Funika vyombo vya kuhifadhia maji.
Lala ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa kila usiku.

impact.en: Leaking or damaged roofs on weak houses
impact.sw: Kuvuja au kuharibika kwa paa za nyumba dhaifu

en: Inspect and repair roofs before the rain starts.
Tie down loose roofing sheets.
Keep food, bedding and documents away from leaking spots.
sw: Kagua na karabati paa kabla mvua haijaanza.
Funga vizuri mabati yaliyolegea.
Weka chakula, matandiko na nyaraka mbali na sehemu zinazovuja.

impact.en: Risk of isolated landslides and mudflows on steep slopes and at the foot of mountains
impact.sw: Hatari ya maporomoko ya ardhi na tope katika miteremko mikali na maeneo ya chini ya milima

en: Avoid steep slopes and mining pits during heavy rain.
Watch for warning signs: new cracks in the ground or walls, tilting trees or poles, muddy springs, rumbling sounds.
If you see these signs, leave immediately and inform local leaders.
Mine operators: divert runoff away from pits and seal trenches leading into mines.
sw: Epuka miteremko mikali na mashimo ya machimbo wakati wa mvua kubwa.
Angalia dalili za hatari: nyufa mpya ardhini au kwenye kuta, miti au nguzo kuinama, chemchemi za maji ya tope, sauti za mngurumo.
Ukiona dalili hizi, ondoka mara moja na toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa eneo.
Wamiliki wa migodi midogo: elekezeni maji ya mvua mbali na mashimo na zibeni mitaro inayoingia migodini.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Significantly reduced visibility, travel delays and some roads impassable
impact.sw: Kupungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa uwezo wa kuona, ucheleweshaji wa safari na baadhi ya barabara kutopitika

en: Avoid non-essential travel.
If you must travel, drive slowly with headlights on and allow extra time.
Follow diversions and instructions from the Traffic Police, TANROADS and TARURA.
sw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima.
Ukilazimika kusafiri, endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele na weka muda wa ziada wa safari.
Fuata njia mbadala na maelekezo ya Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani, TANROADS na TARURA.

impact.en: Many areas affected by heavy rainfall and surface water flooding
impact.sw: Maeneo mengi kuathiriwa na mvua kubwa na maji kutuama

en: Move people, livestock, food and valuables from low-lying areas to higher ground.
Households in known flood-prone areas: move early to a safe place; do not wait for water to reach your house.
Follow instructions from Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Hamisha watu, mifugo, chakula na vitu vya thamani kutoka mabondeni kwenda maeneo ya mwinuko.
Kaya zilizo katika maeneo yenye historia ya mafuriko: hameni mapema kwenda mahali salama; msisubiri maji yafike nyumbani.
Fuata maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Flash floods in streams, gullies and at river crossings
impact.sw: Mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye vijito, makorongo na vivuko vya mito

en: Do not cross flowing water that reaches knee height or covers half a tyre, whether on foot, by motorcycle or by vehicle.
Keep children away from streams, drains and ponds.
Village/Mtaa leaders: guard or close dangerous river crossings.
sw: Usivuke maji yanayotiririka yanayofikia urefu wa goti au kufunika nusu ya tairi, uwe kwa miguu, pikipiki au gari.
Waweke watoto mbali na vijito, mitaro na mabwawa.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: lindeni au fungeni vivuko hatari vya mito.

impact.en: Threat to life from frequent lightning strikes
impact.sw: Hatari kwa maisha kutokana na radi za mara kwa mara

en: Stay inside a solid building; grass-thatched huts and open shelters are not safe.
Fishers and boat operators: do not go out on lakes, rivers or the sea.
Herders and farmers: leave open fields and do not shelter under trees. pro
sw: Kaa ndani ya jengo imara; vibanda vya nyasi na vibanda vilivyo wazi si salama.
Wavuvi na waendesha vyombo vya majini: msiende ziwani, mtoni wala baharini.
Wafugaji na wakulima: ondokeni maeneo ya wazi na msijikinge chini ya miti.

impact.en: Damage to standing crops from waterlogging and runoff
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa mazao shambani kutokana na maji kutuama na kutiririka

en: Open drainage in fields where possible.
Harvest mature crops early and store them in a dry, raised place.
Report crop damage to agricultural extension officers.
sw: Fungua mifereji ya kutolea maji shambani inapowezekana.
Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa mapema na yahifadhi mahali pakavu na palipoinuka.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu wa mazao kwa maafisa ugani wa kilimo.

impact.en: Increased risk of cholera, diarrhoea and other waterborne diseases, and of malaria from mosquito breeding
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa hatari ya kipindupindu, kuhara na magonjwa mengine yatokanayo na maji machafu, na malaria kutokana na kuzaliana kwa mbu

en: Boil drinking water or treat it with chlorine tablets.
Use latrines and wash hands with soap.
Sleep under an insecticide-treated net.
Go to the nearest health facility for diarrhoea or fever.
sw: Chemsha maji ya kunywa au yatibu kwa vidonge vya klorini.
Tumia vyoo na nawa mikono kwa sabuni.
Lala ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa.
Nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu ukiharisha au kupata homa.

impact.en: Damage to roofs and weak buildings from prolonged rainfall
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa paa na majengo dhaifu kutokana na mvua za muda mrefu

en: Move out of weak, cracked or damaged buildings.
Do not climb on roofs during rain or lightning.
Report damage to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Hama kutoka majengo dhaifu, yenye nyufa au yaliyoharibika.
Usipande juu ya paa wakati wa mvua au radi.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Trees falling on roads, power infrastructure and buildings due to saturated soil
impact.sw: Miti kuanguka barabarani, kwenye miundombinu ya umeme na majengo kutokana na udongo kujaa maji

en: Do not shelter under trees.
Stay at least 10 metres from fallen power lines and do not touch them.
Report fallen trees and power lines to local leaders and TANESCO.
sw: Usijikinge chini ya miti.
Kaa angalau mita 10 kutoka nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka na usiziguse.
Toa taarifa ya miti na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka kwa viongozi wa eneo na TANESCO.

impact.en: Significant disruption to infrastructure, water and electricity supply
impact.sw: Usumbufu mkubwa wa miundombinu, huduma za maji na umeme

en: Store safe drinking water, food and essential medicines for at least three days.
Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio for updates.

District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate contingency plans, inspect roads, bridges, power, water and communication services, and pre-position rescue teams, medicines and supplies.
sw: Hifadhi maji safi ya kunywa, chakula na dawa muhimu za angalau siku tatu.
Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri kupata taarifa.

Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura, kagueni barabara, madaraja, huduma za umeme, maji na mawasiliano, na wekeni tayari timu za uokoaji, dawa na vifaa.

impact.en: Unsafe routes to school and possible closure of schools in affected areas
impact.sw: Njia zisizo salama kwenda shule na uwezekano wa kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo yaliyoathirika

en: Parents: do not let children cross rivers, streams or flooded paths to reach school.
School heads: follow closure directives from the District Education Office.
sw: Wazazi: msiwaruhusu watoto kuvuka mito, vijito au njia zilizojaa maji kwenda shule.
Wakuu wa shule: fuateni maelekezo ya kufunga shule kutoka Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.

impact.en: High risk of landslides and mudflows in hazardous areas
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa ya maporomoko ya ardhi na tope katika maeneo hatarishi

en: Households on landslide-prone slopes or at the foot of mountains: move to a safe place before nightfall or heavy downpours.
Keep away from stream channels and gullies below mountains, especially at night.
Stop all farming, quarrying and small-scale mining on steep slopes and in pits.
Report cracks, tilting trees or muddy springs to local leaders immediately.
sw: Kaya zilizo kwenye miteremko hatarishi au chini ya milima: hameni kwenda mahali salama kabla ya usiku au mvua kubwa.
Kaeni mbali na mikondo ya vijito na makorongo yanayotoka milimani, hasa usiku.
Sitisheni kilimo, uchimbaji wa kokoto na uchimbaji mdogo wa madini kwenye miteremko mikali na mashimoni.
Toeni taarifa ya nyufa, miti kuinama au chemchemi za tope kwa viongozi wa eneo mara moja.

impact.en: Evacuation of people from high-risk areas may become necessary
impact.sw: Uhamishaji wa watu kutoka maeneo hatarishi unaweza kuhitajika

en: Prepare an emergency bag: documents, medicines, water, torch and phone charger.
Know your nearest safe shelter and the route to it.
District and Ward Committees: open temporary shelters and alert communities by radio, loudspeaker and door-to-door.
sw: Andaa begi la dharura: nyaraka, dawa, maji, tochi na chaja ya simu.
Fahamu makazi salama ya muda yaliyo karibu na njia ya kufika huko.
Kamati za Wilaya na Kata: fungueni makazi ya muda na toeni tahadhari kwa jamii kupitia redio, vipaza sauti na nyumba kwa nyumba.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Severe, widespread heavy rainfall affecting whole communities
impact.sw: Mvua kubwa kali iliyoenea inayoathiri jamii nzima

en: Residents of flood- or landslide-prone areas: please move early to higher ground or an official shelter, following guidance from Village/Mtaa leaders.
Please do not go back for belongings.
Everyone else: stay inside solid buildings.
Follow instructions from Disaster Management Committees, the Police Force and the Fire and Rescue Force.
sw: Wakazi wa maeneo hatarishi ya mafuriko au maporomoko: tafadhali hamieni mapema maeneo ya mwinuko au makazi rasmi ya muda, kwa kufuata maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Tafadhali usirudi kufuata mali.
Wengine wote: bakini ndani ya majengo imara.
Fuata maelekezo ya Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa, Jeshi la Polisi na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.

impact.en: Severe loss of visibility making travel extremely dangerous
impact.sw: Kupotea kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa uwezo wa kuona na kufanya safari kuwa hatari sana

en: Do not travel unless it is a life-saving emergency.
If caught on the road, stop in a safe place away from rivers, slopes and trees.
Obey road closures and official directives.
sw: Usisafiri isipokuwa kwa dharura ya kuokoa maisha.
Ukiwa safarini, simama mahali salama mbali na mito, miteremko na miti.
Tii ufungaji wa barabara na maelekezo rasmi.

impact.en: Loss of life from drowning, lightning strikes and electrocution
impact.sw: Vifo kutokana na kuzama majini, kupigwa na radi na kunaswa na umeme

en: Never walk, ride or drive into floodwater.
Stay indoors during lightning.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
In an emergency, call 190 or 114 (Fire and Rescue), or inform your local leaders.
sw: Usitembee, usiendeshe pikipiki wala gari kwenye maji ya mafuriko.
Baki ndani wakati wa radi.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Wakati wa dharura, piga simu 190 au 114 (Zimamoto na Uokoaji), au toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa eneo lako.

impact.en: Major landslides and mudflows in steep and mountainous areas
impact.sw: Maporomoko makubwa ya ardhi na tope katika maeneo ya miteremko mikali na milima

en: Residents of steep slopes, stream channels and the valleys below them: please move to safe areas early, following guidance from Village/Mtaa leaders.
Please return only when the authorities declare the area safe.
Report missing or buried people to the Fire and Rescue Force or Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Wakazi wa miteremko mikali, mikondo ya vijito na mabonde yaliyo chini yake: tafadhali hamieni maeneo salama mapema, kwa kufuata maelekezo ya viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Tafadhali rudini pale tu mamlaka zitakapotangaza kuwa eneo ni salama.
Toeni taarifa ya watu waliopotea au kufukiwa kwa Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji au viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Collapse of buildings and major damage to infrastructure
impact.sw: Kuanguka kwa majengo na uharibifu mkubwa wa miundombinu

en: Please move out of weak or damaged buildings.
Do not re-enter collapsed or cracked buildings.
Report trapped people to the Fire and Rescue Force.
District Committees: cordon off unsafe buildings.
sw: Tafadhali hameni kutoka majengo dhaifu au yaliyoharibika.
Usiingie tena kwenye majengo yaliyoanguka au yenye nyufa.
Toa taarifa ya watu waliokwama kwa Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.
Kamati za Wilaya: wekeni uzio kuzunguka majengo yasiyo salama.

impact.en: Severe damage to crops, food stores and livestock
impact.sw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao, maghala ya chakula na mifugo

en: Move livestock and food reserves to higher ground.
Village/Mtaa Committees: report losses to the Ward and District Committees for rapid assessment.
sw: Hamisha mifugo na akiba ya chakula kwenda maeneo ya mwinuko.
Kamati za Vijiji/Mitaa: toeni taarifa ya hasara kwa Kamati za Kata na Wilaya kwa ajili ya tathmini ya haraka.

impact.en: Severe outbreaks of cholera and other waterborne diseases, and rising malaria cases
impact.sw: Mlipuko mkubwa wa kipindupindu na magonjwa mengine yatokanayo na maji machafu, na kuongezeka kwa wagonjwa wa malaria

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Give oral rehydration solution (ORS) at the first sign of diarrhoea and go to a health facility immediately.
Sleep under an insecticide-treated net.
Report suspected cholera cases to the nearest health facility.
sw: Kunywa maji yaliyochemshwa au kutibiwa tu.
Tumia ORS mara dalili za kuhara zinapoanza na nenda kituo cha afya mara moja.
Lala ndani ya chandarua chenye dawa.
Toa taarifa ya wagonjwa wanaoshukiwa kuwa na kipindupindu kwenye kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

impact.en: Loss of water, power, communication and health services for several days
impact.sw: Kukosekana kwa huduma za maji, umeme, mawasiliano na afya kwa siku kadhaa

en: Use stored water and food sparingly.
Rely only on official information: radio, TMA, the Prime Minister's Office and local leaders.
District Committees: set up emergency water points and mobile health services.
sw: Tumia akiba ya maji na chakula kwa uangalifu.
Tegemea taarifa rasmi tu: redio, TMA, Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya dharura vya maji na huduma za afya za mkoba.

impact.en: Large-scale evacuation of people required
impact.sw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa watu unahitajika

en: Follow evacuation orders from the Police Force, the Fire and Rescue Force and Disaster Management Committees.
Help neighbours, older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities to evacuate first.
Register at the shelter.
sw: Fuata amri za uhamishaji kutoka Jeshi la Polisi, Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Wasaidie majirani, wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kuhama kwanza.
Jisajili kwenye makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Closure of schools in many areas; schools used as shelters
impact.sw: Kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo mengi; shule kutumika kama makazi ya muda

en: Keep children at home or in safe shelters under adult supervision.
School heads: open school buildings as shelters only when directed by the District Committee.
Reopen schools only after the District Education Office confirms that buildings and routes are safe.
sw: Wabakize watoto nyumbani au kwenye makazi salama chini ya uangalizi wa watu wazima.
Wakuu wa shule: fungueni majengo ya shule kama makazi ya muda pale tu Kamati ya Wilaya itakapoelekeza.
Shule zifunguliwe tena baada tu ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya kuthibitisha usalama wa majengo na njia.

impact.en: Severe traffic disruption with major roads becoming impassable
impact.sw: Kuathirika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa usafiri na barabara kuu kutopitika

en: Stay off the roads.
Keep emergency routes clear for rescue vehicles and ambulances.
Obey road closures by the Police Force, TANROADS and TARURA.
sw: Epuka kutumia barabara.
Acha wazi njia za dharura kwa magari ya uokoaji na ya wagonjwa.
Tii ufungaji wa barabara unaofanywa na Jeshi la Polisi, TANROADS na TARURA.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please stay with official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
